article.headline: Folgueiras has 27 in Robert Morris' 90-77 win against Saint Francis
article.description: — Alvaro Folgueiras scored 27 points as Robert Morris beat Saint Francis (PA) 90-77 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Folgueiras has 27 in Robert Morris' 90-77 win against Saint Francis
article.story: MOON TOWNSHIP, Pa. -- — Alvaro Folgueiras scored 27 points as Robert Morris beat Saint Francis (PA) 90-77 on Saturday. Folgueiras added 16 rebounds, four steals, and three blocks for the Colonials (8-5). Kam Woods added 19 points while shooting 7 for 16 (2 for 6 from 3-point range) and 3 of 7 from the free-throw line while he also had seven assists and three steals. Amarion Dickerson had 16 points and shot 5 of 8 from the field and 5 for 7 from the line. The Red Flash (3-9) were led in scoring by Riley Parker, who finished with 21 points. Saint Francis also got 19 points and three steals from Juan Cranford Jr.. Valentino Pinedo had 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
